document:5:401:0.text:
Brownpot's Secret
After heating the wok, add Brownpot's <style="highlight">secret spices</style> and stir-fry it until fragrant. Then, put in the <style="highlight">spiky coconut flesh</style> and simmer with water until it completely dissolves. Finally, add the <style="highlight">sawfish steak</style> and cook over low heat until the fish is fully cooked and just beginning to flake.
document:5:401:0.source_cn:
厨师棕点的秘制配方
烧热锅后，先放入棕点的<style="highlight">秘制调料</style>，炒香后加入<style="highlight">甲刺棕椰果肉</style>，加水炖至果肉完全融化。最后下入<style="highlight">锯脂鲳鱼块</style>，小火煮至鱼肉熟透微散即可。
